title: Jmon's Extended Mechanics
description: This mod adds many vanilla+ features to 1.21.4 (newer versions in the future).
body:
# Jmon's Extended Mechanics (JEM)

This mod adds many small features to the game while keeping vanilla minecraft balanced. Inspired by Quark, Cell, and many other Vanilla+ mods, JEM adds more content to every level of vanilla progression, from gravel being craftable using flint, to large, beautiful caverns made of calcite and amethyst. Explore various new biomes, each with their own unique features, blocks, items, and more...

If you want more information on a specific feature in JEM, look at the [DOCS (WIP)](https://github.com/JmonJoshMC/JmonExtendedMechanics)

To report a bug (by the way, thank you in advance for helping me polish any issues), you can [submit a bug report here](https://github.com/JmonJoshMC/JmonExtendedMechanics/issues).


Note: I will be updating this mod regularly (maybe monthly).
